children: Changes in FTSE UK Index Series

Following the receipt of updated shareholder information for Harworth Group, (UK, constituent) as a result of the cash offer by Peel Holdings Group Limited (non constituent) being declared unconditional and with a shareholding in excess of 75%, please see details of affected indexes and effective dates below:
Harworth Group (UK, BYZJ7G4) will be deleted from the FTSE 250 index.
EnQuest (UK, B635TG2) will be added to the FTSE 250 Index and deleted from the FTSE SmallCap Index.
Full details of index changes are available on the FTSE Russell website.
